description: This file contains implementation of OAuth 2.0 authentication message creation functions used in the curl library, including generating OAuth and XOAuth bearer messages.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_auth_create_oauth_bearer_message(const char * user,const char * host,const long port,const char * bearer,struct bufref * out)
methods.description: Generates an OAuth 2.0 bearer message string based on user, host, port, and bearer token for authentication.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_auth_create_xoauth_bearer_message(const char * user,const char * bearer,struct bufref * out)
methods.description: Generates a XOAuth 2.0 bearer message string based on user and bearer token for authentication.
